text_block_list.text:
Protected by the blessings of the Kamuy, 
Matikanefukukitaru secured a great result 
at the Sapporo Kinen.

In high spirits, she and the Trainer 
headed off to do some sightseeing in 
Sapporo.

As I passed in front of the Clock Tower, 
the hands pointed directly south. Lying 
ahead in that direction was Chiba's 
Nakayama Racecourse.

Taking that as a divine revelation, 
Matikane Fukukitaru asked her Trainer if 
she could run in the Arima Kinen.

Not relying on luck like in the Takarazuka 
Kinen, but earning the votes through her 
own strength to run... Matikanefukukitaru 
burned with determination.
